title: Bounce Letters
description: A headline whose letters hop when touched — and do the wave when you click.
usage: The script splits the headline into letter spans; a hover hops one letter on a spring curve, and a click sends a staggered wave down the line. For the one headline a page is allowed to show off with — a launch name, a thank-you, a very confident 404.
a11y: The unsplit sentence lives in an aria-label and the letters are aria-hidden confetti — screen readers get the headline, not forty separate hops. Under prefers-reduced-motion the letters stand still and take their bow as text.
